title: Multilingual And Terminology Parity Sweep For Shell, Compose And Coda
description: Close remaining i18n (locale) gaps and add terminology (vocabulary-swap) support across the JS/Rust UI stack outside the already-swept plugin apps. Scope: (1) framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx shell chrome — remaining hardcoded English strings, e.g. WindowActionPanel's Execute/Reset buttons; (2) compose/client/lib/sketchpad/js/index.ts — hardcoded labels not routed through its existing registerUiTranslationBundles i18n bundle (Version/Kind/Updated/Created by/Path/Node kind/Getting started/Kit/Folder/File/Design/Type/Family and any others found in a full sweep), plus new terminology (native/reuse) support since compose has none today; (3) coda (coda/client/ui/desktop/js, coda/client/bin/assistant/js) — close remaining locale gaps, add terminology plumbing only where an entity noun with an existing alternate vocabulary is actually rendered. Add a small product-neutral terminology-resolver primitive (UiTerminologyLabelSet/createTerminologyLabelResolver/useUiTerminology) to ui/js/react/index.tsx, reusing the existing UI_CHROME_TERMINOLOGY_STORAGE_KEY/UiChromeTerminologyId contract rather than the Rust-only AppDefinition/ViewState boundary, since compose/coda are TS-native products that never cross the WASM plugin boundary. Explicitly out of scope: print/tex (separate babel locale mechanism), and framework/core/rs/lib.rs, framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs, puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs, framework/renderer/react/components/puzzle-2d-board-host.tsx (actively edited by other in-progress tickets).
summary:
Closed remaining i18n gaps and added a TS-native terminology mechanism for the shell chrome, compose, and coda.

Shell chrome (framework/renderer/react): fixed the last hardcoded WindowActionPanel strings ("Execute"/"Reset") to route through shellLabel(ui.common.execute/reset), and found/fixed three more hardcoded strings in components/protocol-list-host.tsx ("Steps"/"Add Step"/"No protocol scene") via new ui.protocolList.* schema keys + useLabel. Added all new EN/DE entries to ui/js/react/index.tsx's UiTranslationSchema and both locale bundles.

New terminology infrastructure (ui/js/react/index.tsx): added UiTerminologyLabelSet<Keys>, createTerminologyLabelResolver(), and useUiTerminology() — a TS analog of the Rust plugin (terminology, locale) -> Labels resolver pattern, built on the already-shared UI_CHROME_TERMINOLOGY_STORAGE_KEY/UiChromeTerminologyId contract so TS-native products (compose, coda) that never cross the WASM plugin boundary can declare/resolve alternate vocabularies without touching Rust AppDefinition/ViewState.

Compose (compose/client/lib/sketchpad/js/index.ts): converted the previously-static SKETCHPAD_KIT_VIRTUAL_FILE_SYSTEM_SCHEMA_MODEL (and its HOME/TREE derivatives) into functions that resolve file-node-kind names and descriptor labels (Version/Kind/Updated/Created by/Path/Node kind, and all 12 entity nouns: Kit/Folder/File/Design/Type/Family/Typology/Piece/Connection/Representation/Port/Connector) via a new composeVfsLabels native/reuse resolver — "reuse" remaps Piece->Building component and Port->Connection point to match puzzle/CAD's existing reuse vocabulary. Also fixed the docs-registry fallback's hardcoded "Getting started"/"Installation" to be locale-aware. Updated the 8 call/test sites accordingly. Compose has no Settings control yet to switch terminology from within compose itself (no settings-panel builder exists there for language either, at parity, not a regression) — flagged as a natural follow-up once that control is built.

Coda (coda/client/ui/desktop/js/renderer.tsx, coda/client/bin/assistant/js/mcp-app.tsx): found and fixed a real bug — both files called `void setUiLocale("en")` unconditionally on load, permanently overriding the shared stored/detected locale and locking coda to English regardless of user preference. Removed both calls (uiI18n's own detector already handles this, matching how compose does it). Registered new coda.* and mcpApp.* translation bundles (EN/DE) via registerUiTranslationBundles and wired the nav sidebar, titlebar (subtitle/sidecar status/refresh), and all ~20 mcp-app.tsx Card titles + panel buttons through useLabel, extracting CodaNavButton/McpPanelButton subcomponents to keep hook calls unconditional. Confirmed via audit that coda has no domain nouns overlapping puzzle/CAD's reuse vocabulary, so no terminology dimension was added there (locale-only, correctly scoped).

Verified: tsc --noEmit clean for ui/js/react and compose's own tsconfig; root tsc shows zero new errors introduced (diffed against pre-existing baseline noise, including known dangling @semio-tech/framework-platform-* package errors that predate this ticket). Live-verified via the protocol-react-dev preview: Steps/Add Step render and function correctly in English, and flipping Settings -> Language to Deutsch correctly re-labels the whole chrome (Schritte, Schritt hinzufuegen, Einstellungen, Sprache, etc.) confirming the new schema keys resolve correctly through the existing i18n pipeline.

Out of scope per dev's explicit choice: print/tex (separate babel locale mechanism). Not touched: framework/core/rs/lib.rs, framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs, puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs, framework/renderer/react/components/puzzle-2d-board-host.tsx (other in-progress tickets own these).

Follow-up flagged separately (spawned as its own background task, not fixed here): compose/client/lib/sketchpad/js/index.ts has a pre-existing, unrelated bug — sketchpadTitleFromDocPath/sketchpadResolveMdxModuleKey/sketchpadLoadMdxModule/sketchpadMdxTitle are each declared twice, which breaks `vitest run` with esbuild "already declared" errors (tsc doesn't catch it). Confirmed via git diff this predates this ticket.
